title: Startup Launches Humanoid Robot for Under $30,000
machine_does: Feather Robotics launched a two-armed wheeled humanoid platform at $29,990, 10 hours per battery set, open SDK so teams can run models from Nvidia, Skild or Physical Intelligence on it.
why_it_matters: A humanoid body at under $30,000 sold as an open platform lowers the price barrier for small teams building robot AI.
date_checked: Read article: dated October 9, 2026 07:04 EDT (= 11:04Z), inside window; not in today's pool or last four days' pools.

title: Kerala police to deploy humanoid robots for traffic management, patrolling on trial basis
machine_does: Kerala police signed an MoU with Kochi firm I Hub Robotics on Friday and unveiled three humanoids (Daksha traffic robot, Thara Gen 1 citizen assistant, Daksha Guardian for emergencies) plus the Kavach ground vehicle; trials start in coming months, deployment aimed within six months, called India's first humanoid traffic policing.
why_it_matters: A state police force in India is putting humanoid robots on traffic duty, a first for the country.
date_checked: Read article: Oct 09, 2026 23:41 IST (=18:11Z), event 'on Friday' (Oct 9) at the c0c0n conference in Kochi; inside window; also carried by Onmanorama and The New Indian Express.

title: Tiny humanoid robot uses an Android phone as its brain and costs just $400 (UCLA PhoneBot)
machine_does: UCLA researchers built PhoneBot, a 48 cm, 1.8 kg legged humanoid (13 motors, no arms) with an old Android phone as brain that walks, follows a person and gets up after a fall; study on arXiv.
why_it_matters: Shows a humanoid robot can be built for about $400 using a phone people already own.
date_checked: Read dev.ua article: dated 9 October 2026 13:46 EEST (=10:46Z); Digital Trends carried it 11:40Z (page blocked, headline only). Date of arXiv paper not stated, so 'new' rests on the reports' date.
note: arXiv paper date not confirmed; low priority.

title: After $3 billion on cars, Faraday Future bets $5 billion on robots
machine_does: Executive chairman Jerry Wang says Faraday Future has 24 robot products on sale (robot dogs and humanoids), shipped 552 by end of August, ~30.9% gross margin in Q2, plans a US robot factory by end of 2026 and 'no less than $5 billion' US investment over ten years; robot unit folded into Nasdaq-listed FFR on Sept 28.
why_it_matters: A struggling EV maker is moving its future into robots, with real shipment numbers but an unfunded $5 billion pledge.
date_checked: Read article: Fri Oct 9, 2026 3:47 PM UTC, inside window. The Sept 28 spinoff is older; the interview figures (552 shipped, margin) are new.
note: Spinoff itself dated Sept 28; the interview is the new item.

title: Metal and muscle: Human-controlled bots brawl in Singapore fight night
machine_does: ARC held Singapore's first full-sized humanoid fight night: professional Muay Thai, MMA and boxing fighters in motion-capture suits controlled Unitree G1 and EngineAI T800 humanoids live in front of 380+ people.
why_it_matters: Shows humanoids used as remote-controlled 'avatars', the same idea behind the California REK fights story.
date_checked: Reuters video 2026-10-09T10:46Z and ARC release dated Oct 9 inside window; the event itself was Wednesday Oct 7 (ARC release, Yahoo Finance/TMX).
note: Event Oct 7, first reported Oct 9; related to the REK story of 7 Oct already in pool (C16-12).

title: Ukraine's all-robotic airborne assaults are becoming a new battlefield reality
machine_does: Ukraine's NC13 unit dropped armed ground robots from heavy bomber drones about six miles behind Russian lines in Operation Vivaldi (tactic 'Gryphon'), the first all-robot airborne assault.
why_it_matters: Robots delivered by drones replace paratroopers and helicopters, a real change in how wars are fought.
date_checked: Read article (paywalled lead): stamped 2026-10-09T16:59Z, inside window; interview 'this week'; not in pool (pool only has 6 Oct gun turrets story).

title: Ukraine's Ground Robots Rescued 45 Soldiers Under Fire, Commander Says
machine_does: Ground robots of Ukraine's Artan intelligence unit evacuated 45 soldiers under fire, covered 4,258 km and carried 41+ tons of supplies over the summer; Zelensky's 2026 target is 50,000 ground drones.
why_it_matters: Ground robots are now saving lives at the front and being bought in tens of thousands.
date_checked: Read article: Oct. 9, 2026, 3:57 pm Kyiv time (RSS 13:13Z), inside window; summer campaign figures newly disclosed.

title: Detroit Debuts Boston Dynamics' Robot Dogs for Urban Innovation Testing
machine_does: Bedrock Detroit and Boston Dynamics will test Spot robot dogs in downtown Detroit as early as next week, including one with an arm that picks up litter as small as a cigarette butt, plus building inspections, parking-garage patrols and package handling.
why_it_matters: A US city is turning its downtown into a test ground for robot dogs doing street cleaning and inspection.
date_checked: Read article: Published Oct 9, 2026 12:33 PM EDT (=16:33Z), inside window.

title: Danu Robotics' fight to build a better recycling robot
machine_does: Edinburgh startup Danu Robotics raised $5 million (late seed) to bring its H.E.R.O. recycling-sorting robot (pincer claw, AI that keeps improving the software) to market; $500,000 of signed contracts and 200+ customers in the pipeline.
why_it_matters: A robot that sorts recycling could cut the hand-sorting work that today lets much recyclable material end up as waste.
date_checked: Read article: 9:45 AM PDT October 9, 2026 (=16:45Z), inside window.

title: B. Riley Securities Advises ChronoScale on the Sale of Ekso Bionics to Wandercraft
machine_does: Wandercraft (French exoskeleton maker) bought Ekso Bionics from ChronoScale; deal closed Sept 30, 2026 and creates a medical exoskeleton company combining Wandercraft's EMEA strength and Ekso's US clinical reach.
why_it_matters: Two of the best-known walking-exoskeleton makers merge into one company.
date_checked: Read article: dated October 9, 2026 02:30 EDT (=06:30Z), at the very start of the window; deal closed Sept 30, announced in this advisory notice.
note: Edge of window; the closing is older (Sept 30).

title: Karnataka woman undergoes robotic heart surgery controlled by a doctor in Barcelona
machine_does: A surgeon in Barcelona reportedly operated a surgical robot remotely to carry out heart surgery on a woman in Karnataka (details from headline only).
why_it_matters: Remote robotic surgery across continents would let patients far away reach specialist surgeons.
